blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the F orm a nd V oid A gent ( FaV-A ), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.
blocks.zh: 正向和负向空间是视觉构成中的一项基本原则,支持视觉连贯的形式和分层的语义关系. 产生这种构成具有挑战性,因为它要求对两个具有共同边界的语义概念进行协调控制。 尽管最近的文本到图像模型和多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)在图像生成和视觉理解方面都取得了很强的性能,但正负空间生成仍然很困难,特别是在直接单通提示下. 在这项工作中,我们提出了F orm a nd V oid A gent (FaV-A),这是一种多式剂,旨在进行正负空间生成. FaV-A遵循一个渐进的工作流程:它首先生成一个基对象,然后分析它的形状和空间结构来识别候选的负-空间语义,最后为最终的图像生成阶段制作成份指令. 实验结果和衰减分析表明,FaV-A提供了一个比直接零发MLLM基线更有效的框架,用于产生视觉上连贯而精准地对齐的正负空间组成.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The interplay between form and void lies at the core of visual composition and is classically expressed through positive and negative space. In art and design, negative space refers to the empty regions around and between the subjects of an image [ 17 , 16 , 4 ] . This principle plays an important role across visual art, photography [ 2 ] , graphic design [ 14 ] , and sculpture [ 25 ] . Designing with negative space requires careful coordination of visual elements, as figure-ground relationships affect not only compositional structure but also semantic interpretation. From a computational perspective, generating such compositions is challenging because the model must simultaneously represent an explicit foreground form and an implicit secondary shape induced by the surrounding space.
blocks.zh: 形式与虚空之间的相互作用是视觉构成的核心,并通过正反空间来典型地表达. 在艺术和设计中,负空间指一个图像的周围和主体之间的空地[17,16,4]. 这一原则在视觉艺术、摄影[2]、平面设计[14]和雕塑[25]之间发挥着重要作用。 用负空间设计需要仔细地协调视觉元素,因为图地关系不仅会影响组成结构,也会影响语义解释. 从计算的角度来说,产生这种成分具有挑战性,因为模型必须同时代表一个明显的前缘形式和由周围空间所诱导的隐含的二次形状.

blocks.en: Recent text-to-image models have shown strong capabilities in visual generation. However, existing generation pipelines often rely on explicit spatial controls, such as masks, layouts, or other manually specified conditions, to manage figure-ground relationships. With the emergence of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 19 , 5 , 21 ] , visual understanding has improved substantially. Nevertheless, a gap remains between understanding and generation: although MLLMs can often recognize and describe positive-negative space compositions, generating such effects in a zero-shot, single-pass setting remains difficult. In our preliminary observations, directly prompting an end-to-end model to synthesize two overlapping semantic concepts with a shared boundary often results in structurally unstable compositions or semantically ambiguous outputs. These observations motivate a staged generation framework in which structure discovery and semantic refinement are separated into successive steps.
blocks.zh: 近期的文本到图像模型在视觉生成方面显示出了强大的能力. 然而,现有的发电管往往依赖于明确的空间控制,如口罩,布局,或者其他人工指定的条件来管理图地关系. 随着多式大语言模型(MLLMs)[19,5,21]的出现,视觉理解得到大幅提高. 尽管如此,在理解和生成之间仍然存在差距:虽然MLLMs经常能够识别和描述正负空间组成,但在零射出单通设定下产生这种效果仍然很困难. 在我们的初步观察中,直接地促使一个端到端模型将两个相重叠的语义概念与共同的边界相融合,往往导致结构不稳定的构成或模棱两可的输出. 这些观测激发出一个分阶段生成框架,其中结构发现和语义精细化被分出相继的步骤.

blocks.en: To address this gap, we adopt a staged generation perspective motivated by common design workflows. In positive-negative space composition, a plausible workflow is to first establish a primary subject, then inspect its contour and spatial structure, and finally refine the image by introducing secondary semantics in the negative space. Following this intuition, we model the task as a sequence of intermediate steps in which earlier outputs provide structural guidance for later stages. This decomposition reduces the burden of requiring a model to resolve shared-boundary geometry and dual semantic alignment in a single generation step. In addition, recent work on MLLM-based agents suggests that explicit intermediate reasoning can be beneficial for complex multimodal generation tasks [ 7 , 8 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了基于共同设计工作流程的分阶段生成视角。 在正负空间构成中,一个可能的工作流程是首先建立一个主主体,然后检查其轮廓和空间结构,最后通过在负空间中引入二级语义来完善图像. 按照这种直觉,我们把这项任务模拟为一系列中间步骤,其中较早的产出为以后阶段提供结构指导。 这种分解减轻了要求一种模型在一代相继阶段解决共享边界几何和双重语义对接的负担. 此外,最近关于基于MLLM的代理人的研究表明,明确的中间推理可以有利于复杂的多式联运生成任务[7、8、6]。

blocks.en: Motivated by this perspective, we present the Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a multimodal agent for positive-negative space generation from abstract topics. Rather than relying on one-shot synthesis, FaV-A adopts a staged workflow. Given a topic, it first generates a base object informed by design-oriented priors. It then analyzes the base image to identify shape and spatial cues that could support a secondary interpretation in the negative space. Finally, these observations are translated into compositional instructions for the final image generation step. As shown in Figure 1 , this staged process yields more coherent positive-negative space compositions in our examples. These results suggest that multimodal agents are a promising direction for design-oriented generation tasks that require coordinated spatial and semantic control.
blocks.zh: 基于这个观点,我们提出了FAV-A(FAV-A)形式和Void Agent(FAV-A),这是一种从抽象话题中产生正负空间的多模式代理。 FaV-A不依靠一发合成,而是采用分阶段的工作流程. 鉴于一个主题,它首先生成一个基于面向设计前科的基对象. 然后分析底图,以识别能支持负空间中二次解释的形状和空间提示. 最后,这些观测结果被翻译为最终图像生成步骤的成份指示. 如图1所显示的,在我们的例子中,这一分阶段过程产生了更为一致的正负空间组成。 这些结果表明,多式联运代理人是面向设计生成任务的有希望的方向,需要协调空间和语义控制。

blocks.en: To summarize, this work makes three contributions. First, we formulate positive-negative space generation as a challenging multimodal design problem that requires coordinated spatial and semantic reasoning under shared-boundary constraints. Second, we propose the Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a staged multimodal agent that decomposes this task into three successive phases: base-object generation, image-aware structural analysis, and instruction-guided final synthesis. Third, through qualitative comparisons, user evaluation, and ablation analysis, we show that this staged framework produces more structurally coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions than direct zero-shot MLLM prompting.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这项工作有三项贡献。 首先,我们将正负空间生成视为一个具有挑战性的多模式设计问题,需要在共同边界限制下协调空间和语义推理。 第二,我们提议采用 " 形式 " 和 " Void Agent " (FAV-A),这是一种分阶段的多模式剂,将这项任务分解为三个相接阶段:基对象生成、图像感知结构分析、以及指导性最终合成。 第三,通过质量比较、用户评价和减速分析,我们显示,这个分阶段框架产生的结构上更加一致和精准地对齐的正负空间组成,而不是直接零镜头的MLLM提示。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Text to Image Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 文本到图像生成

blocks.en: Recent diffusion-based methods have shown that generative models can produce images with multiple valid interpretations under predefined transformations or viewing setups, such as multi-view optical illusions or physically arranged illusion patterns [ 11 , 3 ] . However, these methods typically target fixed transformation rules or illusion mechanisms, rather than discovering a figure-ground composition from an abstract semantic topic.
blocks.zh: 最近的以扩散为基础的方法表明,基因模型可以在预先定义的转换或取景设置下产生具有多种有效解释的图像,如多视光学幻觉或物理排列的幻觉模式[11,3]. 然而,这些方法通常针对固定变换规则或幻觉机制,而不是从抽象的语义主题中发现一个数字-地层组成.

blocks.en: Controllable image generation with explicit structural conditions is also the research focus. Methods such as ControlNet, T2I-Adapter, and GLIGEN enable text-to-image models to follow masks, edges, depth maps, keypoints, bounding boxes, or other grounding signals [ 27 , 18 , 15 ] . These approaches provide strong spatial control once the control signal is available, but they generally assume that the relevant structure has already been specified. In contrast, our setting begins with an abstract topic and requires the system to infer both a suitable primary form and a compatible negative-space interpretation without manually designed spatial templates.
blocks.zh: 具有明确结构条件的可控图像生成也是研究重点. ControlNet,T2I-Adapter,和GLIGEN等方法使文本到图像模型能够跟随口罩,边缘,深度地图,键点,边框,或其他地平信号[27,18,15]. 这些方法在控制信号可用后提供强大的空间控制,但一般认为相关结构已经明确. 相比之下,我们的设定从一个抽象的话题开始,要求系统推断出一个合适的主形式和兼容的负空间解释,而无需人工设计的空间模板.

blocks.en: 2.2 MLLM Agents for Visual Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 MLLM 视觉生成代理

blocks.en: Recent MLLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in visually grounded planning and execution [ 13 ] . In creative and design-oriented settings, PosterLLaVA formulates poster layout generation with multimodal large language models, GenArtist uses an MLLM agent to coordinate image generation and editing through planning and verification, and BannerAgency applies multimodal agents to the creation of editable advertising banners [ 26 , 24 , 23 ] . GraphicBench further shows that graphic design remains challenging for language agents, especially when reasoning about spatial relationships and coordinating global dependencies across design decisions [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 近期基于MLLM的代理人在视网膜规划和实施方面表现出了强大的能力[13]. 在以创意和设计为导向的设置中,PosterLlaVA用多模式大语言模型来制定海报布局生成,GenArtist使用一个MLLM代理通过规划和验证来协调图像生成和编辑,而BannerInstitute应用多模式代理来创建可编辑的广告横幅[26,24,23]. Graphic Bench还表明,图形设计对语言代理仍然具有挑战性,特别是在对空间关系的推理和协调设计决定的全球依赖性[12]时.

blocks.en: These works motivate the use of staged multimodal reasoning for design tasks, but they primarily focus on layout planning, tool orchestration, or editable asset generation. Our work instead targets positive-negative space synthesis, where the central challenge is to derive a shared-boundary figure-ground composition from an abstract topic through intermediate image analysis and compositional anchoring.
blocks.zh: 这些作品激发了对设计任务采用分级的多模式推理,但它们主要侧重于布局规划,工具管弦,或可编辑的资产生成. 相反,我们的工作目标是正负空间合成,其中心挑战是通过中间图像分析和组成定位,从抽象专题中得出一个共同的边界图地构成。

blocks.en: 3.1 Overall Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 总体结构

blocks.en: We propose the Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a multimodal agent for positive-negative space generation built on a large multimodal model, denoted by ℳ \mathcal{M} . Given an abstract textual topic 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , the goal of FaV-A is to generate a final composition 𝐈 final \mathbf{I}_{\mathrm{final}} together with a textual description 𝒟 final \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{final}} that captures the intended figure-ground duality.
blocks.zh: 我们提议采用由M\mathcal{M}表示的Form和Void Agent(FAV-A),这是一种基于大型多模式的正负空间生成的多模式代理。 鉴于一个抽象的文本主题T\ mathcal{T},FaV-A的目标是生成一个最终的成分 I final\mathbf{ I}_{\ mathrm{ final} 加上文本描述 D final\mathcal{ D}_{\ mathrm{ final} ,它能够捕捉预定的图地二元.

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , unlike layout-controlled generation pipelines that depend on manually specified masks, edges, or spatial layouts, FaV-A follows a staged and mask-free generation process. Instead of directly mapping 𝒯 \mathcal{T} to the final image in a single step, the agent decomposes the task into three sequential stages. In Stage I, Topic-Driven Semantic Planning ( ℳ plan \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{plan}} ), the agent converts the input topic into a base-object prompt and a high-level compositional plan, guided by design priors 𝒫 prior \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{prior}} . In Stage II, Multi-Modal Spatial Parsing and In-Context Anchoring ( ℳ parse \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{parse}} ), the agent generates a base image and analyzes its shape and spatial structure to derive constraints for negative-space composition. In Stage III, Mask-Free Entangled Synthesis ( ℳ syn \mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{syn}} ), the agent uses the base image and the derived structural cues to produce the final positive-negative space composition.

We provide the planning model with a system prompt containing design priors 𝒫 prior \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{prior}} , which encourage attention to figure-ground structure, negative space, and compositional balance. The prompts, design priors and detailed pipeline will be included in our Supplementary Material.

blocks.en: 3.4 Stage III: Guided Final Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.4 第三阶段:指导性最后综合

blocks.en: The final stage generates the target positive-negative space composition from the intermediate outputs of the previous stages. Rather than relying on manually specified bounding boxes, masks, or edge-based control signals, FaV-A conditions the synthesis process on both the base image and a detailed compositional prompt.
blocks.zh: 最后阶段从前几个阶段的中间产出产生目标正负空间组成. FaV-A不依靠手动指定的边框,口罩,或以边缘为主的控制信号,而是在基础图像和详细的成份快取上为合成过程提供条件.

blocks.en: Formally, the synthesis stage is defined as ( 𝐈 final , 𝒟 final ) = ℳ syn ​ ( 𝐈 base , 𝒫 anchor ) , (\mathbf{I}_{\mathrm{final}},\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{final}})=\mathcal{M}_{\mathrm{syn}}(\mathbf{I}_{\mathrm{base}},\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}}), (7) where 𝐈 base \mathbf{I}_{\mathrm{base}} provides the initial visual structure and 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} provides text-based guidance for the intended figure-ground composition. The output image 𝐈 final \mathbf{I}_{\mathrm{final}} is the final synthesized result, while 𝒟 final \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{final}} is a textual description of the semantic relationship expressed in the composition.
blocks.zh: 在形式上,合成相被定义为 (I final, D final) = M syn (I Base, P s锚地), (\ mathbf{ I}_{\-mathrm{ finally}},\ mathcal{ D}_{\-mathrm{ finnal}}) → M}_{\-mathrm{ syn}} (\mathb{i}_{\-mathrm{base}},\mathcal{P}_{\-mathrm{anchor}})), (7) I base 的 \ mathbf{ I}_{\ mathrm{ base} 提供了初始视觉结构, P 主播 \ mathcal{ P}_{\ mathrm{ annchor} 提供了基于文字的指南 , 用于预期的图面组成 。 输出图像 I final \ mathbf{ IQQ mathrm{ final}是最终的合成结果,而 D final \ mathcal{ DQQQ mathrm{ final}}是对组成中表达的语义关系的文字描述.

blocks.en: This stage integrates the intermediate structural analysis and the compositional prompt into the final generation process, enabling mask-free positive-negative space synthesis under multimodal conditioning.
blocks.zh: 这一阶段将中间结构分析与组成快感结合到最终生成过程中,使得在多模式调节下能够进行无遮罩正负空间合成.

blocks.en: 4 Results and Discussions
blocks.zh: 4 结果和讨论

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.1 与最新基线的比较

blocks.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of our multi-stage architecture, we compare FaV-A against direct prompting baselines utilizing state-of-the-art closed-source multimodal models, specifically Gemini (Gemini 3.1 [ 22 ] ), GPT (gpt-image-1.5 [ 20 ] ), and Claude (Sonnet 4.6 [ 1 ] ). We conducted all experiments using gemini-3.1-flash [ 10 ] as the understanding (MLLM) model and gemini-3.1-flash-image [ 9 ] as the image generation model. In this setup, the baseline models are provided with the target abstract topic alongside explicit theoretical definitions and principles of positive-negative space design. Concretely, all closed-source baselines are prompted with the same instruction: Definition of Positive-Negative Space Art (Form and Void): Positive-negative space refers to a composition where the positive shape (the subject) and the negative space (the area around it) are equally important and interdependent. In advanced design, they are “entangled”—meaning they share a common, single contour line. The boundary of the positive form must perfectly define the shape of another meaningful element in the negative space, creating a visual pun or dual meaning (figure-ground reversal). Based on the definition above, please autonomously design and generate a minimalist black-and-white artwork for the topic: “ { T ​ o ​ p ​ i ​ c } \{Topic\} ”. In this way, the baselines are given access to the same high-level conceptual knowledge as FaV-A during its planning stage.
blocks.zh: 为了评估我们多阶段架构的有效性,我们比较了FaV-A与直接触发基线的关系,这些基准使用最先进的封闭源码多式联运模式,特别是双子座(Gemini 3.1 [22])、GPT(gpt-image-1.5 [20])和克洛德(Sonnet 4.6 [1])。 我们用Gemini-3.1-flash[10]作为理解(MLLM)模型和Gemini-3.1-flash-image[9]作为图像生成模型进行了所有实验. 在这一设置中,基线模型与正负空间设计的明确理论定义和原则一起,得到了目标抽象专题. 具体地说,所有封闭源基线都是用同一个指令来激发的:正-负空间艺术的定义(形式和活性):正-负空间是指正外形(主体)和负空间(其周围区域)具有同等重要性和相互依赖性的构成. 在高级设计中,它们是 " 缠绕 " 的 -- -- 意思是,它们有一条共同的单一轮廓线。 正态的分界必须完美地定义负空间中另一个有意义的元素的形状,产生视觉的双关或双重含义(图-地倒转). 根据上述定义,请自主地设计并制作一本关于这个主题的最低限度的黑白艺术作品:“{To o p i c}{Topic}。 这样,基线就可以在规划阶段获得与FaV-A相同的高级概念知识。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Visual comparison between state-of-the-art baselines (Gemini, Claude, and GPT) and our FaV-A. Given the same topic and positive-negative space design knowledge, the baselines fail to achieve true topological entanglement: Claude defaults to semantic juxtaposition, GPT relies on explicit spatial partitioning,
and Gemini resorts to internal part-filling. Only FaV-A successfully entangles both subjects along a continuous shared boundary, achieving true bistable perception.
blocks.zh:
图3:最新基线(Gemini、Claude和GPT)与我们的FaV-A的可视比较。 鉴于同一主题和正负空间设计知识,基线未能实现真正的地貌缠绕: Claude默认为语义并列,GPT依赖于明确的空间分化,
双子座则采用内部部分填充. 只有FaV-A成功将两个主体缠绕在一个连续的共享边界上,实现真正的双相感知.

blocks.en: When provided with the augmented prompt (topic + design knowledge), the baseline models are generally able to capture the target concepts and produce high-contrast black-and-white images. Nevertheless, a clear gap remains between semantic understanding and positive-negative space execution. As shown in Figure 3 , rather than forming two mutually defined shapes through a shared boundary, the baselines exhibit three representative failure patterns: • Semantic Drift and Weak Topic Grounding (Claude): Claude exhibits the weakest alignment with the intended topics. Although it occasionally produces clean black-and-white graphics, its outputs often fail to preserve the core semantic concepts specified in the prompt. This issue is particularly evident in Rose and Love and War and Peace , where few clearly recognizable topic-related elements remain. Hence, Claude’s limitation is not only its inability to realize positive-negative space structure, but also its insufficient topic grounding. As a result, its outputs lack both semantic fidelity and the dual-form coupling required for effective positive-negative space design. • Topic-Consistent but Additive Composition (Gemini): Gemini generally preserves the target concepts and produces recognizable topic-relevant objects. However, its dominant strategy is additive composition, typically by stacking, juxtaposing, or locally inserting one object into another. While semantically consistent, such layouts rarely achieve the figure-ground coupling central to positive-negative space art. Instead, the generated forms remain illustrative rather than structurally interdependent. Consequently, Gemini produces coherent topic-driven graphics, but lacks the contour sharing, ambiguity, and formal tension characteristic of strong positive-negative space compositions. • Graphic Plausibility without True Figure-Ground Reversal (GPT): GPT shows the strongest overall design sensibility among the direct-prompting baselines. Relative to simple object juxtaposition, it more often yields compositions with clearer visual hierarchy, stronger symbolic organization, and better poster-like readability. However, these results are better characterized as literal graphic design than genuine positive-negative space design. Multiple concepts are typically integrated through explicit depiction or layout-level composition, rather than being jointly defined by a shared contour across positive and negative regions. Therefore, although GPT approaches visually compelling conceptual design, it still falls short of the stricter figure-ground entanglement required in positive-negative space art.
blocks.zh: 在提供增强的即时(专题+设计知识)时,基准模型一般能够捕捉出目标概念并生成高相接的黑白相接图像. 尽管如此,语义理解与正负空间执行之间仍然存在明显的差距. 如图3所示,基线不是通过共同边界形成两个相互界定的形状,而是显示出三种有代表性的故障模式: 语义漂流和弱主题地平地(克洛德): Claude表现出与预定主题最弱的一致。 虽然它偶尔会产生干净的黑白相间的图形,但其输出往往无法保存快报中指定的核心语义概念. 这个问题在Rose和Love以及战争与和平中尤其明显,在这些地方,与专题有关的因素很少得到明确承认。 因此, Claude的局限性不仅在于它无法实现正负空间结构,而且在于它未充分确定主题。 因此,其产出既缺乏语义上的忠诚,也缺乏有效正负空间设计所需的双形式结合。 • 主题一致但具有附加性的组成(Gemini):双子座一般保留目标概念并产生可识别的主题相关对象。 然而,其主导策略是添加剂成分,通常通过堆放,并联,或者在当地将一个物体插入到另一个物体. 虽然这种布局在本质上是一致的,但很少实现对正负空间艺术至关重要的图地相接。 相反,所产生的形式仍然是说明性的,而不是结构上的相互依存。 因此,双子座生成连贯的由主题驱动的图形,但缺乏强烈正负空间构成的轮廓共享、模糊和形式紧张的特点。 · 无真相图-圆回转(GPT): GPT在直接即期基线中显示出最强的整体设计敏感性. 相较于简单的对象并列,它更常产生具有更清晰的视觉分层,更强的象征性组织,以及更好的海报可读性等成分. 然而,这些成果的特点是文字图形设计,而不是真正的正负空间设计。 多种概念通常通过明确的描述或布局层次的构成加以整合,而不是通过横跨正负区域的共同轮廓共同定义. 因此,虽然GPT采用了视觉上令人信服的概念设计,但它仍然没有达到正负空间艺术所要求的更严格的图地缠绕。

blocks.en: Advantages of the FaV-A Architecture. In contrast, our proposed method successfully achieves structural entanglement by reformulating the visual illusion as a progressive, constrained reasoning task. Rather than expecting an MLLM to perform zero-shot spatial alignment in a single generation step, FaV-A utilizes a base image to establish an initial geometric foundation. By conducting multi-dimensional visual parsing on this base image, the agent synthesizes a precise semantic spatial anchor ( 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} ). This anchor explicitly maps the semantic requirements to specific topological regions (e.g., instructing the model to align a facial profile with the jagged external edge of a primary object). Guided by these rigorous spatial constraints, the final synthesis stage aligns the conflicting visual priors, forcing the positive and negative spaces to share a single, continuous contour. This methodology ensures the reliable emergence of bistable perception, realizing the “one shape, dual meaning” principle that direct prompting baselines cannot achieve.
blocks.zh: FaV-A建筑的优点. 相形之下,我们提出的方法成功地实现了结构缠绕,将视觉幻觉重新表述为一个进步的,受制约的推理任务. FaV-A不期望一个MLLM在一代步骤中进行零发空间对接,而是利用一个基像来建立初始几何基础. 通过对这个碱基图像进行多维可视化剖析,该剂合成了精确的语义空间锚(P s锚\mathcal{P}_{\-mathrm{anchor}}). 这个主锚明确将语义要求映射到特定的地貌区域(例如,指示模型将面部剖面图与主对象的相接外缘相匹配). 以这些严格的空间限制为取向,最终的合成相配合了相冲突的视觉前传,迫使正反相间的空间共享一个单一,连续的轮廓. 这一方法确保了二元感的可靠出现,实现了直接触发基线无法实现的“一形二义”原则。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Ablation study on the “Chess and Player” (top) and “Petting a Cat” (bottom) topics. (a) Full FaV-A Pipeline , showcasing strong figure-ground interplay and shared boundaries; (b) w/o Topic Analysis , resulting in a shallow vertical juxtaposition; (c) w/o Detailed Base Prompt , introducing early semantic deviation (e.g., generating a dragonfly instead of a player); (d) w/o Image Feature Analysis , leading to a loss of structural fidelity and morphological drift; (e) w/o Specific Composition , causing visual confusion and semantic bleeding; (f) w/o Multi-modal Generation , leading to complete structural dissolution (e.g., the cat arbitrarily transforms into a dog).
blocks.zh: 图4:关于“化学和玩家”(上)和“养猫”(下)专题的研究。 (a) 完全FaV-A管道,显示强烈的图地相互作用和共同边界;(b) w/o专题分析,导致浅浅的纵向并列; (c) w/o详细基础即时,引入早期语义偏差(例如生成一只龙而非玩家); (d) w/o图像地貌分析,导致结构上的忠诚和形态上的漂移; (e) w/o特定构成,造成视觉上的混乱和语义上的出血; (f) w/o多模式生成,导致结构的完全解体(例如,猫被任意地转化为一只狗)。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Quantitative results of the ablation study based on human evaluation ( N = 50 N=50 ). Metrics are evaluated on a 5-point Likert scale (higher is better). Our full FaV-A pipeline significantly outperforms all ablated variants across Topic Adherence (TA), Gestalt Quality (GQ), and overall Aesthetic Score (AS).
blocks.zh: 表1:根据人类评价进行的消毒研究的定量结果(N=50N=50)。 计量按5分的Ikrt尺度(较高更好)进行评价。 我们的全FAV-A输油管大大超越了Tobject Atition(TA)、Gestalt Quality(GQ)和整体审美分数(AS)中所有消散的变体。

blocks.en: To rigorously quantify these qualitative observations, we conducted a user study ( N = 50 N=50 ) to evaluate the ablated variants across three dimensions: Topic Adherence (TA), Gestalt Quality (GQ), and overall Aesthetic Score (AS) on a 5-point Likert scale. The participants were recruited from graduate students and researchers with prior experience in visual design, computer vision, or digital art, including a subset with formal design training. During evaluation, all results were anonymized and presented in randomized order, such that the raters were unaware of which method produced each image. Each participant was asked to score the generated artworks independently based on the three criteria, following a unified instruction sheet describing the meaning of each metric. This procedure was adopted to reduce presentation bias and improve the reliability of subjective assessment.
blocks.zh: 为了严格量化这些定性观测,我们进行了一项用户研究(N=50 N=50),以评价三个层面的减速变体:主题遵守(TA)、Gestalt质量(GQ)和整体审美分数(AS),分量为5分。 学员从具有视觉设计、计算机视觉或数字艺术方面经验的研究生和研究人员中招聘,包括具有正式设计培训的子集。 在评价期间,所有结果都是匿名的,并按随机排列的顺序呈现,因此评分者不知道哪一种方法产生出每个图像. 要求每位学员按照说明每个计量标准含义的统一指示表,根据三项标准独立对生成的艺术品进行评分。 采用这一程序是为了减少列报偏差,提高主观评估的可靠性.

blocks.en: As reported in Table 1 , the full FaV-A pipeline significantly outperforms all ablated variants. The quantitative results strongly align with our visual findings: notably, the removal of topic analysis causes a severe drop in TA (1.35), reflecting the model’s inability to follow the semantic prompt. Meanwhile, the absence of specific compositional constraints (GQ: 1.85) and the bypass of multi-modal generation (GQ: 1.60) incur the heaviest penalties in Gestalt Quality, statistically confirming their indispensability in maintaining the structural illusion.
blocks.zh: 如表1所报告,全FaV-A输油管的性能大大超过所有减速变体。 定量结果与我们的视觉结论非常吻合:特别是,删除专题分析导致TA(1.35)严重下降,反映出模型无法遵循语义提示。 同时,由于没有具体的组成限制(GQ: 1.85)和绕道多模式生成(GQ: 1.60),在Gestalt质量方面受到最重的处罚,在统计学上证实了它们在维持结构错觉方面是必不可少的.

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.2 读取研究

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of each functional module within the FaV-A pipeline, we conduct a set of ablation studies using the abstract topics “Chess and Player” and “Petting a Cat”. For each configuration, we remove or simplify a single component while keeping the remainder of the pipeline unchanged. Figure 4 visualizes the qualitative degradation in structural coherence and positive-negative space entanglement when individual stages are ablated.
blocks.zh: 为了验证FaV-A管道内每个功能模块的有效性,我们利用“化学和玩家”和“搭配一只猫”这两个抽象专题进行一系列的消化研究。 对于每个配置,我们移除或简化单个组件,同时使管线的剩余部分保持不变. 图4可视化了单个阶段收缩时结构一致性和正负空间缠绕的质量退化.

blocks.en: Topic Analysis. The primary role of this module is to decompose an abstract concept into candidate positive and negative entities and establish their initial spatial relationship. For the ablation, we bypass the semantic planning and feed the raw topic directly to the subsequent stages. The absence of this preliminary logic causes the output to degenerate into a shallow juxtaposition of elements (see Figure 4 (b)). In the “Petting a Cat” example, the design merely stacks a hand silhouette and a cat silhouette vertically, lacking intentional interaction. In contrast, the full pipeline allows the hand to act as a negative shape that wraps around and gently strokes the cat’s head, demonstrating a much stronger figure-ground interplay (see Figure 4 (a)).
blocks.zh: 专题分析。 本单元的主要作用是将抽象概念分解为候选正负实体并确立其初始空间关系. 为了通融,我们绕过语义规划,直接将原始话题输入后期. 由于没有这种初步逻辑,产出会退化成一些要素的浅薄并列(见图4(b))。 在“Petting a Cat”的例子中,该设计只是垂直地堆放出一只手和一只猫,缺乏有意的相互作用。 与此相反,整个输油管使手能起负外形来包围并轻轻地打出猫头鹰的头部,显示出更强大的图地相互作用(见图4(a))。

blocks.en: Base Object Prompt. This module translates the topic into morphological instructions to synthesize a base image capable of supporting negative space carving. For the ablation, we replace the LLM-derived instructions with a generic manual prompt: “Positive or negative shapes representing { topic } ” . As observed in the upper example of Figure 4 (c), this underspecified prompt introduces severe semantic deviation at the source—generating an irrelevant dragonfly-like shape due to an unstable interpretation of the word “player”. This error propagates through the pipeline, proving that precise initial morphological constraints are essential to prevent downstream semantic drift.
blocks.zh: 基础对象提示 。 这个模块将这个话题转化为形态学指令来合成一个能够支持负空间雕刻的基础图像. 关于减缩,我们将LLM衍生的指令取而代之,取而代之的是通用的手动提示:“代表{专题}的动能或负能”。 如图4(c)的上图所示,这种不精确的瞬间在源头引入了严重的语义偏差——由于对 " 玩家 " 一词的不稳定解释,产生了一种无关紧要的"苍蝇"形状. 这种错误通过管道传播,证明精确的初始形态限制对于防止下游语义漂移至关重要.

blocks.en: Image Feature Analysis. This stage grounds the spatial reasoning in the actual geometry (e.g., shape characteristics, visual hierarchy) of the generated base image. As illustrated in Figure 4 (d), removing this multi-dimensional parsing disconnects the refinement process from the original base object. Consequently, the final outputs suffer from a loss of structural fidelity: in the upper example, the player’s hair characteristics are noticeably altered; in the lower example, the cat’s pose drifts. This analysis is particularly crucial for a human-in-the-loop workflow, where the intermediate base form selected by a designer must remain morphologically stable during final generation.
blocks.zh: 图像地物分析. 这个阶段在生成的基像的实际几何学(如形状特征,视觉分级)中为空间推理提供了依据. 如图4(d)所显示,去除这种多维解析将完善过程与原基对象脱节. 因此,最终产出在结构上失去忠诚:在上个例子中,玩家的发型特征明显地被改变;在下个例子中,猫的姿势漂移. 这种分析对于人入室工作流程尤为重要,在工作流程中,由设计师选择的中间基态必须在最终生成时保持形态稳定.

blocks.en: Specific Composition. The purpose of this component is to synthesize a localized spatial anchor ( 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} ) that dictates exactly how the contours should be sculpted. We ablate this by substituting the detailed anchor with a naive instruction: “Transform this into a POSITIVE-NEGATIVE SPACE poster. CRITICAL: Use ONLY pure black and pure white…” As shown in Figure 4 (e), without the detailed topological constraints, the model exhibits morphological drift and weakened visual harmony. The positive and negative shapes become visually confused (e.g., overlapping messily in the chess example) or fail to preserve the intended object configuration (e.g., the number of cats inexplicably changes in the lower example).
blocks.zh: 具体构成. 此组件的目的是合成一个本地化的空间锚( P s锚\ mathcal{P}_{\- mathrm{ annchor} ),它精确地决定了轮廓应如何被雕刻. 我们通过用天真的指示取代详细的锚来减少这种情况:“将它变成一个积极-积极空间海报。 纯黑色和纯白色...” 如图4(e)所示,没有详细的地貌限制,模型显示出形态漂移并削弱视觉和谐. 正面和负面的外形会变得视觉上混淆(如棋子上杂乱无章地重叠),或者无法保留预定对象的配置(如下级例子中猫的数量难以解释的变化).

blocks.en: Multi-modal Generation. The final (I&T) to (I&T) stage enforces high-frequency edge preservation by integrating the accumulated visual and textual priors. By bypassing this dedicated reasoning pass and directly feeding the intermediate inputs to a standard image generator (Figure 4 f), the system fails to consolidate the spatial constraints. This results in structural dissolution, where the visual illusion collapses entirely. Most notably, in the lower example, the cat is arbitrarily transformed into a dog, indicating that without this final reasoning mechanism, the shape priors established in earlier stages are completely ignored.
blocks.zh: 多式联运。 最终(I&T)到(I&T)相位通过将所积累的视觉前传和文字前传相融合,执行高频边缘保存. 通过绕过这个专用推理通道并直接将中间输入输入输入到一个标准图像生成器(图4 f),系统未能整合空间限制. 这导致结构解体,视觉幻觉完全崩溃. 最出名的是,在下个例子中,猫被任意地变成一只狗,这表明如果没有这种最终推理机制,早期所建立的形状前缀完全被忽略了.
(a) 国家
(b) 国家

(Top) Examples demonstrating zero-shot semantic-to-spatial entanglement and structural coherence in multi-stable perception. (Bottom) Typography series showcasing cross-domain alignment and Gestalt emergence.
blocks.zh: 图5: FaV-A自主生成的正负空间组成结果。 (Top)在多稳定感知中表现出零发语义对空间的缠绕和结构一致性的例子. (Bottom) Typtography系列显示跨域对接和Gestalt出现.

blocks.en: 4.3 Discussions of Results by FaV-A
blocks.zh: 4.3 FaV-A对结果的讨论

blocks.en: Here we qualitatively evaluate the autonomous compositions generated by our FaV-A (see Figure 5 ). Rather than merely viewing these outputs as static artistic artifacts, we regard them as both exquisite artistic works and as empirical evidence of the MLLM’s capacity to execute complex zero-shot topological reasoning. In this discussion, we not only present the generated results but also provide in-depth analyses of the AI-generated design drafts that underpin these compositions. These results validate how the abstract duality of “Form and Void” is successfully grounded in precise visual geometries through our multi-modal reasoning pipeline, thereby imbuing the artworks with profound interpretive depth.
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们从质量上评价FaV-A产生的自主组成(见图5)。 我们不只把这些产出视为静态的艺术作品, 在本次讨论中,我们不仅介绍了所产生的结果,而且还对这些构成基础的人工智能设计草案进行了深入分析。 这些结果证实了“形式和活字”的抽象双重性是如何通过我们的多式推理管道成功地以精确的可视地貌来建立起来的,从而使艺术品具有深刻的解释性。

blocks.en: Traditional generative models typically struggle to map semantic intent to negative space, often defaulting to generating isolated foreground forms without explicit mask guidance. FaV-A, however, transforms spatial absence into a highly structured semantic entity. In Silent Duel: Between the Pieces and Their Masters (see Figure 5(a) (1)), the negative space surrounding the chess piece is precisely sculpted into a human profile in the latent space. Similarly, in Phantom of Peace: A Doomsday Mushroom Cloud Beneath the Olive Branch (see Figure 5(a) (3)), the mushroom cloud is synthesized entirely through the absence of surrounding textures rather than explicit contours. This demonstrates the agent’s robust semantic-to-spatial entanglement, effectively translating the rich cognitive constraints of the semantic anchor ( 𝒫 anchor \mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{anchor}} ) into complex topological boundaries without human-engineered layouts.
blocks.zh: 传统的基因模型一般会挣扎地将语义意图映射到负空间,常常默认生成孤立的前地形式而没有明确的口罩指向. 然而,FaV-A将空间缺位转化为高度结构化的语义实体. 在"寂静的决斗:碎片与它们的主人公"中(见图5(a)(1)),围棋棋子的负空间被精确地雕刻成潜入空间的人类外貌. 同样地,在"和平之影:末日蘑菇"中"橄榄分会"(见图5(a)(3))中,蘑菇分会完全通过缺乏周围的纹理来合成出蘑菇分会而并非清晰的轮廓. 这证明了代理人的强健的语义对空间的缠绕,有效地将语义锚(P s锚\mathcal{P}_{\-mathrm{anchor}}})丰富的认知约束转化为复杂的地貌边界而无需由人类所设计的布局.

blocks.en: A fundamental technical challenge in generating visual illusions is maintaining structural coherence across overlapping visual elements without causing morphological collapse or semantic bleeding. FaV-A overcomes this by enforcing high-frequency edge preservation guided by its internal cross-modal attention mechanisms. In Whispered Kiss Beneath the Rose (see Figure 5(a) (2)), a couple’s interaction subtly emerges from the intrinsic curves of the rose, effectively blending surface geometry and hidden subtext. In Harmonious Gaze: Poetry of Cat and Cat/Dog in Silent Companionship (see Figure 5(b) (Left)), both the primary silhouette and the embedded negative-space figures maintain high visual legibility. This confirms the agent’s capacity to simultaneously optimize two distinct visual priors along a shared, continuous boundary, ensuring dual-semantics within a single structural contour.
blocks.zh: 产生视觉错觉的一个基本技术挑战是保持重叠视觉元素之间的结构一致性而不会造成形态崩溃或语义出血. FaV-A通过在其内部跨模式关注机制的指导下实施高频边缘保护,克服了这一问题. 在Whispered Kiss Beneth the Rose(见图5(a)(2))中,一对夫妇的相互作用潜出玫瑰的内在曲线,有效地混合了地表几何和隐藏的子文字. 在"和谐之地"(Harmonious Gaze: Cat and Cat/Dog in Silent Companium)中(见图5(b)(Left)),主色调和嵌入式负空间人物都保持高可视性. 这证实代理人有能力沿着一个共同的、连续的边界同时优化两个不同的视觉前兆,确保单一结构轮廓内的双重语义。

blocks.en: We further explore the agent’s generalization capabilities in cross-domain scenarios involving typography. In the CAT/DOG typography series (see Figure 5(b) (Right)), text characters and animal silhouettes are fused into bistable configurations that resist immediate deterministic classification. For a standard vision model, textual forms and biological contours typically belong to disparate latent distributions, making seamless integration difficult. Yet, FaV-A successfully navigates this dual constraint: it interprets textual forms as the rigid “ground” while dynamically embedding animal silhouettes into the enclosed negative spaces. This algorithmic emergence of Gestalt perception highlights the MLLM’s advanced compositional reasoning, proving its proficiency in handling conflicting multi-objective spatial tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步探索代理人在涉及打字的跨域情景中的通缩能力. 在CAT/DOG打字机系列(见图5(b)(右))中,文本字符和动物 silhouette被融合成可抵制立即确定分类的双表配置. 就标准视觉模型而言,文字形式和生物轮廓通常属于不同的潜在分布,因此难以无缝地融合。 然而,FaV-A成功地导航了这一双重制约:它将文字形式解释为僵硬的"地"而动态地将动物的圆筒嵌入封闭的负空间. Gestalt感知的这种算法式的出现突出了MLLM的高级组成推理,证明了它在处理相冲突的多目标空间任务的熟练程度.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced Form and Void Agent (FaV-A), a novel autonomous multi-modal system designed to synthesize complex positive-negative space compositions based on abstract textual topics. By formulating visual illusions as a sequence of high-level cognitive reasoning tasks, we bypass the heavy reliance on explicit spatial masks and structural templates prevalent in existing controlled diffusion models. Our proposed three-stage pipeline successfully integrates topic-driven semantic planning, in-context spatial anchoring, and mask-free (I&T) to (I&T) synthesis. Experimental results demonstrate that FaV-A not only executes cross-modal visual alignment with high structural coherence but also exhibits advanced zero-shot topological reasoning capabilities, such as multi-stable perception and cross-domain typographic integration. Ultimately, FaV-A highlights the immense potential of Large Multimodal Models to serve as autonomous cognitive partners in high-level aesthetic design, paving the way for more sophisticated, semantic-driven computational artistry.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了Form和Void Agent(FAV-A),这是一种新型的自主多模式系统,旨在以抽象的文字主题为基础,合成复杂的正负空间组成. 通过将视觉幻觉形成为高级认知推理任务的序列,我们绕过了对现有可控扩散模型中普遍存在的显性空间口罩和结构模板的强烈依赖. 我们提议的三阶段管道成功地将主题驱动的语义规划,内接空间锚定,和无遮罩(I&T)到(I&T)合成. 实验结果表明,FaV-A不仅执行与高结构一致性的跨模式视觉对接,而且还展现出先进的零镜头地貌推理能力,如多稳定感知和跨域打字集成. 归根结底,FaV-A突出了大型多式模型作为高级美学设计中的自主认知伙伴的巨大潜力,为更精密、语义驱动的计算艺术铺平了道路。
